entries.title: Psalms 74:1
segments: ¶<<Maschil of Asaph.>> O God, why hast thou cast [us] off for ever? [why] doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture? {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction}

words.text: ? {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 74:2
segments: Remember thy congregation, [which] thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, [which] thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt. {rod: or, tribe}

entries.title: Psalms 74:3
segments: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; [even] all [that] the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 74:4
segments: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns [for] signs.

entries.title: Psalms 74:5
segments: [A man] was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

words.text: according as he had lifted up

entries.title: Psalms 74:6
segments: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

entries.title: Psalms 74:7
segments: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled [by casting down] the dwelling place of thy name to the ground. {They have cast...: Heb. They have sent thy sanctuary unto the fire}

words.text: . {They have cast...: Heb. They have sent thy sanctuary unto the fire}

entries.title: Psalms 74:8
segments: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land. {destroy: Heb. break}

entries.title: Psalms 74:9
segments: We see not our signs: [there is] no more any prophet: neither [is there] among us any that knoweth how long.

words.text: : neither [is there] among us any that knoweth

entries.title: Psalms 74:10
segments: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

entries.title: Psalms 74:11
segments: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck [it] out of thy bosom.

entries.title: Psalms 74:12
segments: ¶For God [is] my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 74:13
segments: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters. {divide: Heb. break} {dragons: or, whales}

entries.title: Psalms 74:14
segments: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, [and] gavest him [to be] meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 74:15
segments: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers. {mighty...: Heb. rivers of strength}

entries.title: Psalms 74:16
segments: The day [is] thine, the night also [is] thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 74:17
segments: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter. {made: Heb. made them}

entries.title: Psalms 74:18
segments: ¶Remember this, [that] the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and [that] the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:19
segments: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude [of the wicked]: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 74:20
segments: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

entries.title: Psalms 74:21
segments: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:22
segments: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

entries.title: Psalms 74:23
segments: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually. {increaseth: Heb. ascendeth}
